[API guide and safe quickstart](../integration/api-reference.md) · [Methods](methods.md) · [Schemas](schemas.md) · [HTTP routes](http.md)

Derived from `protocol/openapi.json`. These routes exist only when the host explicitly enables loopback HTTP. Authentication is header-based; never put pairing codes, bearer tokens or credentials in a URL. See [HTTP pairing](../integration/api-reference.md#http-pairing) before calling protected routes.

The OpenAPI document describes the contract subset, not every transport rejection status or runtime semantic bound. SSE is the session event stream; use RPC for inventory journal reads.

<a id="http-get-runtime-pairing-code"></a>

## GET `/runtime/pairing-code`

Read the active loopback pairing code without consuming it. Same-origin only; no-store. Expires after five minutes and becomes unavailable after redemption or ten failed attempts.


| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful response | `application/json`: `object` |
| 403 | Pairing code unavailable or request origin denied | `application/json`: `object` |

### Response 200: `application/json`

| Field | Required | Wire type | Constraints / description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `string` | pattern: `"^[a-f0-9]{12}$"` |
| `expiresInSeconds` | yes | `integer` | minimum: `1`; maximum: `300` |

Additional properties are forbidden by this schema.

<a id="http-post-runtime-pairing-code"></a>

## POST `/runtime/pairing-code`

Explicitly issue a fresh single-use loopback pairing code. Replaces the current unused code without revoking already paired clients. Same-origin only; no-store.


| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful response | `application/json`: `object` |
| 403 | Request origin denied | `application/json`: `object` |

### Response 200: `application/json`

| Field | Required | Wire type | Constraints / description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `string` | pattern: `"^[a-f0-9]{12}$"` |
| `expiresInSeconds` | yes | `300` | — |

Additional properties are forbidden by this schema.

<a id="http-get-v1-events"></a>

## GET `/v1/events`

Authorized server-sent events. Explicit event-gap errors; reconnecting never re-runs a turn.

- **query `sessionId`** (optional): `string`.
- **query `after`** (optional): `string`.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | SSE update/gap events | `text/event-stream`: `string` |

<a id="http-post-v1-pair"></a>

## POST `/v1/pair`

Redeem a host-issued single-use code. Does not widen host grants. Codes expire after five minutes.


**Request body:** `application/json` — `object`

| Field | Required | Wire type | Constraints / description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `code` | yes | `string` | minLength: `12`; maxLength: `12` |

Additional properties are forbidden by this schema.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
|---|---|---|
| 200 | Successful response | `application/json`: `object` |
| 403 | Pairing denied | `application/json`: `object` |

### Response 200: `application/json`

| Field | Required | Wire type | Constraints / description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expiresInSeconds` | no | `integer` | — |
| `protocolVersion` | no | `string` | — |
| `token` | no | `string` | — |

This schema permits additional properties; runtime checks can be stricter.
